title: Spirit of Truth, Essential God
description: Spirit of Truth, Essential God in Tonic Solfa to MELITA, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley wrote these words. His brother John printed them in A Collection of Hymns for the Use of the People Called Methodists (1780), hymn 255.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Long Metre, six lines (8.8.8.8.8.8), and this page sets them to MELITA; any other Long Metre, six lines tune fits them as well.
underlay: Spir-it of truth, es-sen-tial God, Who didst thy an-cient saints in-spire, Shed in their hearts thy love a-broad, And touch their hal-lowed lips with fire; Our God from all e-ter-ni-ty, World with-out end we wor-ship thee!

lines: Who didst thy ancient saints inspire,
Shed in their hearts thy love abroad,
And touch their hallowed lips with fire;
World without end we worship thee!
Whose presence fills both earth and heaven,
The meaning of the written word
The secret mind of God to man.
The scriptures to our hearts apply;
And, taught by thee, we God revere,
In each the Triune God adore,
Who was, and is for evermore.

source: John Wesley, A Collection of Hymns for the Use of the People Called Methodists (1780)
licence: Public domain: Charles Wesley died in 1788.
credits: Words by Charles Wesley (1707–1788), public domain, as printed in John Wesley's Collection of Hymns (1780); set to MELITA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
